My current record is 140+ over 3 days. I spent three days at Bilbo's Gasthaus in Krummenau, and my bar tab at checkout was 138 Bitburgers. Then add in the 3-5 random beers I'd have while driving around the German countryside during the day, and the real number is probably closer to 155.

In all fairness, I'd spent about 6 weeks training to get to that number. Four of us were working in Turkey, and spent every night at the hotel bar. One of the guys I was traveling with is a DoD contractor, and his company was footing the bill as long as we were in Turkey. Our smallest bar tab was around $380, the largest was $1,800, and we did this every single night. For six fucking weeks. I was in the best drinking shape of my life when we descended upon this sleepy little German village, and they had no idea what hit them. On the second day, the innkeeper's daughter had to drive to the next town over to buy beer because we had consumed all the Bitburger in Krummenau.

To this day, drinking that little German town out of beer is one of my proudest moments.
